verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing ships built-in event-triggered automations. When an invoice becomes overdue or a payment fails, it can automatically send reminders or retry the payment, and email notifications and reminders are configurable. However, the evidence shows only these preset behaviors, not a general user-defined rules engine; webhooks are a developer building block and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose rule builder (custom conditions and actions on arbitrary events), detail on how far the automatic collection settings can be configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: If the invoice becomes overdue, or payment on the invoice fails, Stripe can automatically send reminders or retry the payment for you.
You can configure Stripe to send email notifications or reminders to your customer
